notes: Accessed entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab (no HTTP client, proxy or reader used). robots.txt (www.muji.com/robots.txt) names no Claude/Anthropic agent and disallows only /jp/enquete/, /tw/passport/terms/ and two account paths - extraction permitted. The store is a Next.js App-Router RSC app with no __NEXT_DATA__ and no client XHR for listings; every section page is fully server-rendered, so the tree and the counts were pulled with same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context via javascript_tool and parsed locally with DOMParser. TREE SOURCE: three sources unioned - (1) the mega-menu on the Furniture department page, (2) each section page's own CategorySelectionModal node list (the site's authoritative parent/child category tree, which is deeper than the mega-menu), (3) the department landing page /cmdty/section-top/furniture-storage-electronics, whose section links were diffed against the global menu link set and produced no furniture node not already found. The category sitemap (/jp/sitemap_xml/sitemap_jp_section_1.xml, 1480 section ids) was also fetched and diffed against the discovered ids by id-prefix family; every unseen hit resolved to a level-4/5/6 variant node (shelf side panels, shelf boards, parts, sofa covers, seat-count/cushion-fill variants such as 'Sofa Body Series > Urethane Pocket Coil > 2.5 Seater' and '> Ottoman'), to IDEE non-furniture branches, or to unrelated departments - no missed furniture category. QTY SOURCE: Rule 1 rendered listing header ('N件中 1件〜40件表示') taken from the SSR pager lead of each canonical section URL. CORROBORATION: for three categories the header was checked against an independent enumeration of unique /cmdty/detail/ product ids in the grid - Dining Tables 24/24, Dining Chairs 33/33, Chests 11/11 - so on this site the header is exact and counts products, not colourways. Counts also vary per category (43 to 751), so it is not a site-wide total. Every leaf URL returned HTTP 200 and its breadcrumb chain was verified to be the node requested (trap 2/3: identity taken from the section id, never the label). STRUCTURE: MUJI's Furniture department (家具, D00019, 751 items) has ten children; sub-nodes are a mix of product types, material/series lines and parts. Recorded the deepest node that lists furniture; skipped every 'すべての〜' (All X) node per section 3. EXCLUDED as out of scope: Mattresses (10) and Bed Parts (21) under Beds & Mattresses; every cover-only sofa node (Sofa Bench covers-only 11, Wooden Sofa Frame covers-only 3, Old Sofa Covers 3, Unit Sofa Covers, Body-Fit Sofa Cover 7); Scratch-Prevention and Repair Goods (5) under Storage Furniture; IDEE Lighting (T110011); the whole Storage Cases department (D00016, 347 - boxes, files, PP cases), Bedding (D00041), Interior Goods (D00020, 426 - slippers, cushions, curtains, rugs, blinds), Appliances/Lighting/Clocks (D00021) and IDEE Goods/Art/Wear. No outdoor/garden furniture exists: the Green, Gardening & Pet department (D00048) contains only Pet Supplies, Gardening Goods and Plants. Sibling counts overlap by design (the ten department children sum to 816 against a department total of 751; the three sofa seat-size nodes sum to 58 against their parent's 52) - MUJI cross-files SKUs across series and size facets. Nothing was summed or inferred; every qty is the site's own number for that exact URL. Two leaf rows share the display name 'Living and Dining Multi-Use Series' (S10314 under Sofas, 32; S2000607 under Tables, 27) - genuinely different listing pages with different URLs, both kept and flagged.
